user_profile.other_preferences: Need a fast job, Intermediate (Built small projects) Coding experience, familiar with python, java,C++,R languages. Already build some academic projects, preferable language are Python and R.

learning_plan.execution_strategy_summary: This roadmap is meticulously crafted to transform your robust CSE foundation into a high-impact Product/Marketing Data Analyst skill set. We're ruthlessly prioritizing production-grade SQL and Python for analysis, leveraging your existing coding proficiency. By fast-tracking into practical application of statistics, A/B testing, and Power BI, we'll quickly bridge your academic strengths with critical industry demands, building a project-ready portfolio that screams 'hire me' within just three months.

monthly_plan.theme: Solidifying Your Data Foundation & Kickstarting Your Portfolio
weekly_micro_goals: Week 1: You'll dive deep into advanced SQL, mastering Window Functions and Common Table Expressions (CTEs) so you can effortlessly extract and transform complex user activity and marketing data. Focus on using these powerful tools to calculate metrics like rolling averages and user ranks.

Week 2: This week, you'll tackle more intricate SQL, focusing on advanced JOIN types, subquery optimization, and basic indexing strategies. This is crucial for designing queries that are not just correct but also performant, just like in a real production environment. You'll start applying these directly to your project's data extraction needs.

Week 3: Now, we switch gears to Python! You'll master Pandas DataFrames and Series, focusing on efficient data loading, initial cleaning (missing values, data types), and advanced indexing. Your existing Python skills will give you a head start here, allowing you to quickly move beyond basics.

Week 4: You'll continue with Python and Pandas, focusing on merging and concatenating DataFrames from different sources (like your SQL output and other CSVs). You'll also learn efficient grouping operations and custom aggregations, which are vital for structuring your project's raw data into an analysis-ready format.
technical_skills_to_master: Production-grade SQL (Window Functions, CTEs, Advanced JOINs, basic optimization)
Pandas DataFrames and Series mastery (cleaning, merging, basic aggregations)
Efficient data ingestion from various sources (SQL, CSV)
interview_prep_goals: Start practicing intermediate SQL queries on platforms like LeetCode or HackerRank (focus on medium-level window function and JOIN problems).
Begin outlining answers to common behavioral questions using the STAR method.
what_you_will_build: A robust SQL script that extracts raw product/marketing event data, calculates initial aggregated metrics (e.g., daily active users, basic conversion rates) using advanced SQL features, and outputs a clean dataset.

A Python script (using Pandas) that ingests this SQL output and performs further cleaning, handles missing values, corrects data types, and merges it with supplementary user demographic data, preparing it for deeper analysis.
job_hunt_action_items: Draft your resume, focusing on quantifying academic project achievements and highlighting your CSE background.
Optimize your LinkedIn profile with keywords relevant to Data Analyst roles (Product/Marketing focus).
Start researching target companies and roles to understand common job descriptions.

curated_resources.recommended_search_term: LeetCode SQL problems (Medium level) / HackerRank SQL
Mode Analytics SQL Tutorial (Advanced Section) / PostgreSQL Official Docs (Window Functions)
Wes McKinney Python for Data Analysis / Pandas Official Documentation

monthly_plan.milestone_deliverable: A comprehensive SQL query and a corresponding Python script that together produce a clean, analysis-ready base dataset for your portfolio project, clearly documented and demonstrating advanced SQL and Pandas capabilities.

weekly_micro_goals: Week 5: You'll wrap up your Python data manipulation skills, focusing on advanced Groupby operations, time-series analysis (crucial for product/marketing data), and basic feature engineering to prepare your dataset for statistical modeling.

Week 6: This week is all about statistical foundations. Leverage your strong CSE mathematical background to quickly grasp descriptive and inferential statistics, sampling, and key probability distributions. You'll apply these concepts using Python's SciPy and Statsmodels libraries.

Week 7: Now, we dive into the core of data-driven decision-making: Hypothesis Testing. You'll learn the framework, understand p-values and significance, and apply parametric tests (t-tests, ANOVA) and non-parametric tests (Chi-squared) to your project data to answer specific business questions.

Week 8: You'll transition into A/B testing and experimentation design, a crucial skill for Product/Marketing Analysts. You'll learn how to formulate hypotheses, calculate sample sizes, understand common pitfalls, and interpret results to make actionable recommendations. You'll simulate an A/B test analysis in Python for your project.
technical_skills_to_master: Advanced Python for data analysis (Pandas Groupby, Time Series, basic Feature Engineering)
Practical application of descriptive and inferential statistics (Hypothesis Testing, Confidence Intervals)
A/B Testing and Experimentation Design (sample size, power analysis, interpretation)
interview_prep_goals: Practice SQL and Python coding challenges related to data analysis scenarios (e.g., 'Find the conversion rate difference between groups').
Prepare for case study interviews focused on A/B testing design and interpretation.
Refine behavioral answers, focusing on problem-solving and collaboration examples.
what_you_will_build: An extended Python script that performs advanced statistical analysis on your project's dataset, answering specific business questions using hypothesis tests (e.g., comparing conversion rates between user segments).
A simulated A/B test analysis in Python, demonstrating your ability to design an experiment, calculate sample size, and interpret results, leading to data-driven recommendations for your project.
job_hunt_action_items: Begin identifying and connecting with professionals in Product/Marketing Data Analyst roles on LinkedIn.
Start crafting personalized outreach messages for informational interviews or networking opportunities.
Attend virtual industry meetups or webinars if available.

curated_resources.topic: Python for Data Science (Stats & ML basics)
curated_resources.recommended_search_term: Data Science from Scratch by Joel Grus / Towards Data Science (Stats section)
Khan Academy Statistics (Advanced) / Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments by Kohavi et al.
SciPy Official Documentation / Statsmodels Getting Started Guides

monthly_plan.milestone_deliverable: A Python analysis notebook/script (for your project) that performs robust statistical analysis, including hypothesis testing and a simulated A/B test, complete with clear interpretations and initial actionable insights.

monthly_plan.theme: Storytelling, Strategy & The Job Hunt Hustle
weekly_micro_goals: Week 9: It's time to visualize your findings! You'll master data storytelling principles and create compelling visualizations using Python (Matplotlib, Seaborn, and an introduction to Plotly/Dash for interactive elements). You'll start building an interactive dashboard for your project.

Week 10: Now, the industry-standard tool: Power BI. You'll learn Power BI fundamentals – data acquisition, data modeling (DAX for calculated measures), and building interactive dashboards. Your goal is to replicate and enhance key insights from your Python analysis into a polished Power BI dashboard for your project.

Week 11: This week focuses on Product & Marketing Business Acumen. You'll learn critical metrics (CAC, LTV, conversion funnels) and how to translate ambiguous business questions into data problems. This bridges your technical skills with the 'why' behind the analysis, making you highly valuable. You'll also integrate supporting tools like Git for version control and advanced Excel/Google Sheets for ad-hoc analysis.

Week 12: This is the 'hustle' week! You'll finalize your portfolio project, write a professional README, and aggressively apply for jobs. Heavy focus on mock interviews (technical SQL/Python, behavioral STAR method), tailoring your resume, and refining your communication skills to articulate your project's impact effectively.
technical_skills_to_master: Data Visualization & Storytelling (Python Plotly/Dash, Matplotlib, Seaborn)
Power BI (Data Modeling, DAX, Interactive Dashboard Development)
Product & Marketing Business Acumen (metrics, stakeholder management, data strategy)
Advanced Spreadsheet Proficiency (Excel/Google Sheets for ad-hoc analysis)
Cloud Data Platform Concepts (overview of modern data architectures)
interview_prep_goals: Conduct 3-5 mock technical interviews (SQL, Python, A/B testing scenarios).
Practice explaining your portfolio project end-to-end, focusing on business impact and technical choices.
what_you_will_build: A polished, interactive Python dashboard (using Plotly/Dash) visualizing key findings from your project.
A comprehensive Power BI dashboard for your project, showcasing your data modeling and DAX skills, providing actionable insights for product/marketing teams.
A professional README.md file for your portfolio project repository, detailing the problem, solution, technologies, and key insights.
job_hunt_action_items: Launch your job application campaign, tailoring your resume and cover letter for each specific role.
Engage in active networking – follow up with connections, participate in online communities.
Solicit feedback on your resume and LinkedIn profile from mentors or peers.

curated_resources.recommended_search_term: Guy in a Cube (Power BI) / Microsoft Learn Power BI
Plotly Dash Official Documentation / Towards Data Science Plotly Dash Tutorials
Learn Git Branching / GitHub Docs Getting Started

monthly_plan.milestone_deliverable: A fully deployed (or shareable) interactive Python dashboard and a comprehensive Power BI dashboard for your capstone project, alongside a professional GitHub repository with a compelling README, a refined resume, and a LinkedIn profile ready for intense job applications.

critical_guidelines: Embrace the '70/30 Rule': For every 10 hours, spend no more than 3 on reading or tutorials. The other 7 hours *must* be spent actively coding, querying, and building. This hands-on approach is your fastest path to production readiness.

Practice Ruthless Time-Boxing: When you hit a bug or get stuck, set a timer (e.g., 30-60 minutes). If you haven't made significant progress, reach out for help (online forums, peers) or move on to a different task. Spinning your wheels is a productivity killer.

Your Portfolio is Your Interview: Forget cliché projects. Every line of code, every query, and every dashboard you build must be part of your evolving, end-to-end Product/Marketing Data Analyst project. Focus on solving real-world problems and clearly articulating your impact.

Mandatory Rest & Buffer Hours: That 10-15% buffer isn't just for debugging; it's for your mental well-being. Take proper breaks, step away from the screen, and recharge. Burnout is real, and consistency over intensity is the key to sustained progress.

Speak the Business Language: Always connect your technical work back to business value. For every query, analysis, or dashboard, ask yourself: 'What business question does this answer? What decision does this inform?' This mindset is what differentiates a great analyst.
learning_plan.final_readiness_summary: Congratulations! After these intensive three months, you won't just be a CSE graduate; you'll be a highly sought-after Product/Marketing Data Analyst. Your strong academic foundation, combined with your newly honed production-grade SQL, Python, statistical analysis, A/B testing, and Power BI skills, will make you an irresistible candidate. You'll be ready to extract insights from complex data, design impactful experiments, and translate technical findings into clear, actionable business strategies, giving you a distinct competitive advantage in the global market. Get ready to land that fast job!
